app.title: ProCirculariTool
app.tagline: Calculate a product circularity indicator (PCI) based on a Bill-of-Materials (BoM). Based on the methodology by <0>Braquené et al. (2020)</0>

upload.title: Upload or sample
upload.desc: Load a BoM from file, sample, or manual entry.

mapping.title: Column mapping
mapping.desc: Map source columns to the canonical schema.

upload.title: Step 1 – Bring your BoM
upload.subtitle: Upload CSV/XLSX, load a sample, or create rows manually.
upload.privacyNotice: Files are parsed locally in your browser. No BoM data leaves the tab.
upload.manualEntryHint: Create or tweak rows directly in the browser.
upload.previewHint: Map the columns in the next step.

mapping.title: Step 2 – Map your columns
mapping.subtitle: Align your source headers to the canonical fields used by the tool.
mapping.recommendedHeaders: Recommended headers: component_id, component_name, component_mass_kg, component_quantity, material_type, material_mass_per_component_kg. Unmapped columns are ignored.
mapping.massBalanceErrorItem: Component {{component}}: materials sum to {{materials}} vs component_mass_kg {{declared}} (Δ {{diff}}). Adjust the component mass or the material_mass_per_component_kg entries for this component.
mapping.massBalanceErrorHint: Material masses must add up to component_mass_kg. Differences above {{tolerance}}% are blocked to avoid incorrect PCI results.
mapping.massBalanceWarningItem: Component {{component}}: materials sum to {{materials}} vs component_mass_kg {{declared}} (Δ {{diff}}). The gap is within {{tolerance}}% but should be corrected if possible.
mapping.noRows: No BoM rows loaded yet. Upload or load a sample first.

parameters.title: Step 3 – Parameters
parameters.subtitle: Choose the level for each parameter, then fill it once. Values inherit down the hierarchy to avoid duplicate work.
parameters.levelSelectionTitle: Where do you want to set each parameter?
parameters.levelSelectionHint: Product-level values apply to all components and materials; component-level values cascade to materials. Switch levels only when you need more detail.
parameters.componentUseFactors: Parameters set at component level (cascading to materials).
parameters.materialRowHelper: Parameters shown here are set to material level. Others are inherited from component or product levels.
parameters.inheritanceHint: These values cascade to all components and materials unless overridden at lower levels.

labels.fr: F_r – Fraction of recycled content of the produced feedstock
labels.cu: C_u – Fraction of product at end of use collected for reuse of component
labels.cr: C_r – Fraction of product at end of use collected for material recycling
labels.ccp: C_cp – Fraction of material losses recovered as scrap during component production
labels.cfp: C_fp – Fraction of material losses recovered as scrap during feedstock production
labels.ems: E_ms – Efficiency of material separation process
labels.erfp: E_rfp – Efficiency of recycled feedstock production
labels.intensity: I – Use intensity during use phase
labels.intensityDesign: I_d – Assumed use intensity during design stage based on average consumer behavior
labels.lifetime: L – Period of time product is in use (years)
labels.lifetimeDesign: L_d – Design life of a product (years) based on average market expectation
